questions.question: If (x²-1)/(x)=8, then what is the value of (x⁶-1)/(x³)= ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x²-1)/(x)=8

**Formula used:**

If (x - (1)/(x)) = k, then (x³ - (1)/(x³)) = k³ + 3k

**Calculation:**

⇒ (x²)/(x) - (1)/(x) = 8

⇒ x - (1)/(x) = 8

⇒ (x⁶-1)/(x³) = x³ - (1)/(x³)

⇒ x³ - (1)/(x³) = 8³ + 3 × 8

⇒ 512 + 24

⇒ 536

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: Radius of a circle is 10 cm. What will be the angle made by a chord of length 20 cm on the circumference of this circle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a circle is 10 cm.

A chord of length 20 cm is drawn.

**Concept used:**

The diameter of a circle subtends an angle of 90° at the circumference of the circle.

The diameter is the largest chord of a circle.

The length of the diameter = 2 × Radius

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87be8185c0ebee90915499fefb516174a64790635427e00177e936a770d8cf73.png] 

Let the radius of the circle be R cm.

According to the concept,

R = 10 cm

So, Diameter = 2 × R = 2 × 10 = 20 cm

According to the question,

The chord has a length of 20 cm.

A diameter divides the circle into two semi-circles, each having an angle of 90 degrees at the circumference of the circle.

So, the angle made by the chord (diameter in this case) at the circumference of the circle is 90 degrees.

Therefore, the correct answer is 1) 90 degrees.

questions.question: 12 men can do a work in 8 days while 4 boys can do it in 40 days. In how many days 9 boys and 3 men together will complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

12 men can do a work in 8 days while 4 boys can do it in 40 days.

**Concept Used:**

M₁D₁ = M₂D₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ 12M × 8 = 4B × 40

⇒ 3M = 5B

⇒ M : B = 5 : 3

Total work = 12 × 5 × 8 = 480

9 boys and 3 men together will complete the same work in = 480/(9 × 3 + 3 × 5)

⇒ 480/42

⇒ 80/7 days

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If 6 Cot θ = 5, then find the value of (6 cos θ + sin θ)/(6 cos θ - 4 sin θ)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given that **6 cot θ = 5**, we can simplify the required expression.

Divide both the numerator and the denominator by **sin θ** to convert the terms into **cot θ**.

Expression = (6 cot θ + 1) / (6 cot θ − 4)

Substitute **6 cot θ = 5** directly: (5 + 1) / (5 − 4) = 6 / 1 = 6.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** 6 cot θ = 5

**Formula Used:** cot θ = Base / Perpendicular = cos θ / sin θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5378fa034db30f5c2fad89a6c9f09e8d145565bf33c94101f7549e52e85fe707.png] 

⇒ 6 cot θ = 5 ⇒ **cot θ = 5/6**

⇒ Since cot θ = cos θ / sin θ, we can assume **cos θ = 5k** and **sin θ = 6k**.

⇒ Required value = (6 cos θ + sin θ) / (6 cos θ − 4 sin θ)

⇒ Substituting the values: [6(5k) + 6k] / [6(5k) − 4(6k)]

⇒ Value = (30k + 6k) / (30k − 24k)

⇒ Value = 36k / 6k = 6

The calculated result 6 matches Option 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratio Identities

The fundamental quotient identity for cotangent is **cot θ = cos θ / sin θ** and for tangent is **tan θ = sin θ / cos θ**.

Reciprocal Relationships

The cotangent function is the reciprocal of the tangent function: **cot θ = 1 / tan θ**.

Pythagorean Identity

Another important identity involving cotangent is **1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ**.</p

questions.question:
The line chart given below shows the expenditure of two companies R and S in different years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e01f58ef9bd963206ca0bf95beae1fdcecd9234a6b2766d16f2ad1c73bbb359e.png] 

Which of the following statement is NOT correct?

I. The expenditure of R in year Y1 and Y2 together is (Approximate) 81.66 percent of the expenditure of S in year Y3 and Y4 together

II. The total expenditure of company S is (Approximate) 112.12 percent of the total expenditure of company R.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Statement I:

The expenditure of R in year Y1 and Y2 together = 600 + 500 = 1100

The expenditure of S in year Y3 and Y4 together = 700 + 500 = 1200

Percentage of the expenditure of R in year Y1 and Y2 together to the expenditure of S in year Y3 and Y4 together = 1100/1200 × 100 = 91.66%

Statement I is not correct.

Statement II:

Total expenditure of company S = 1200 + 900 + 700 + 500 + 400 = 3700

Total expenditure of company R = 600 + 500 + 800 + 400 + 1000 = 3300

Percentage of the total expenditure of company S to the total expenditure of company R = 3700/3300 × 100 = 112.12%

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: A chair is marked for Rs. 210 and sold for Rs. 189. Find the discount rate for this transaction.
questions.solution:

Marked price = (M.P) = Rs. 210

Selling price = (S.P) = Rs. 189

Formula used:

If marked price is M.P, selling price is S.P and discount is D, then

Discount = M.P - S.P

Rate of discount = (100/M.P) × Discount

Calculation:

Discount = 210 - 189 = Rs. 21

questions.question: The ratio of the volume of first and second cylinder is 32 ∶ 9 and the ratio of their heights is 8 ∶ 9. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 616 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volumes** (V₁/V₂) = (r₁/r₂)² × (h₁/h₂)

32/9 = (r₁/r₂)² × (8/9) ⇒ (r₁/r₂)² = 4 ⇒ r₁/r₂ = 2/1

**Base Area** of second cylinder = 616 cm² ⇒ πr₂² = 616 ⇒ r₂ = 14 cm

**Radius** of first cylinder (r₁) = 2 × r₂ = 2 × 14 = 28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 28 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of **Volumes** = 32 : 9, Ratio of **Heights** = 8 : 9, **Base Area** of 2ⁿd cylinder = 616 cm².

**Formula Used:** Volume of **Cylinder** = Base Area × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acd11ded285ffb9d0a1886a97b13357940389a3d8856036753a3263898651acd.png] 

⇒ V₁ / V₂ = (Area₁ × h₁) / (Area₂ × h₂)

⇒ 32 / 9 = (Area₁ / 616) × (8 / 9)

⇒ 32 / 8 = Area₁ / 616

⇒ Area₁ = 4 × 616 = 2464 cm²

⇒ π × r₁² = 2464

⇒ 22/7 × r₁² = 2464

⇒ r₁² = (2464 × 7) / 22 = 112 × 7 = 784

⇒ r₁ = √784 = 28 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 28 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The volume (V) is calculated as the product of the base area and the height: V = πr²h.

Surface Area of a Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(r + h).

Radius and Area Relation

If the base area is A, then the radius r = √(A/π). For A = 616 cm², r = 14 cm.</p

questions.question: ΔEFG is a right angled triangle. ∠F = 90 degree, EF = 10 cm and FG = 15 cm. What is the value of cosec G?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides **EF : FG** = 10 : 15 = 2 : 3.

In a right triangle with sides 2 and 3, **Hypotenuse (EG)** = √(2² + 3²) = √13 units.

For ∠G, **Perpendicular** = EF = 2 units and **Hypotenuse** = √13 units.

**cosec G** = Hypotenuse ÷ Perpendicular = √13 / 2.

**∴ The correct answer is √13/2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** In ΔEFG, ∠F = 90°, **EF** = 10 cm, **FG** = 15 cm.

**Formula:** **Pythagoras Theorem:** EG² = EF² + FG² | **cosec G** = Hypotenuse / Opposite side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36264dca0903ebdca3276fae850fc3fe3bd1dc2c6adb00b6aba25eea0e4083cd.png] 

⇒ In **ΔEFG**, by **Pythagoras Theorem**:

⇒ EG² = 10² + 15²

⇒ EG² = 100 + 225 = 325

⇒ EG = √325 = √(25 × 13) = 5√13 cm

⇒ **cosec G** = Hypotenuse / Perpendicular (Opposite to G)

⇒ cosec G = EG / EF

⇒ cosec G = (5√13) / 10

⇒ cosec G = √13 / 2

**∴ The correct answer is √13/2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratio Definitions

In a **right-angled triangle**, **sin θ** = Perpendicular/Hypotenuse, **cos θ** = Base/Hypotenuse, and **tan θ** = Perpendicular/Base.

Reciprocal Relations

**cosec θ** is the reciprocal of **sin θ** (1/sin θ), **sec θ** is the reciprocal of **cos θ** (1/cos θ), and **cot θ** is the reciprocal of **tan θ** (1/tan θ).

Pythagoras Theorem

For any right triangle with legs **a**, **b** and hypotenuse **c**, the relationship is always **a² + b² = c²**.</p

questions.question: Ritika purchased 'x' kg wheat at Rs.30/kg and sold 8 kg of this at Rs. 'x' per kg and remaining at Rs. 45/kg. Overall profit percent earned is 10%, then what quantity of wheat Ritika sold at Rs. 45/kg?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Overall Selling Price = 30 × 1.10 = Rs. 33/kg.

Equating total SP parts: 8x + 45(x − 8) = 33x

53x − 360 = 33x ⇒ 20x = 360 ⇒ x = 18

Quantity sold at Rs. 45/kg = x − 8 = 18 − 8 = 10 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 30/kg, Overall profit = 10%

Quantity sold at Rs. x/kg = 8 kg

Quantity sold at Rs. 45/kg = (x − 8) kg

**Formula Used:**

Mean SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

Alligation ratio = (SP₂ − Mean SP) / (Mean SP − SP₁)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1e397aa89bdb403bbae6ee7345ab77a8827f5393cb629151f5ae37df3dfb4c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Mean Selling Price = 30 × 1.1 = Rs. 33/kg

⇒ Using the Alligation ratio: 8 / (x − 8) = (45 − 33) / (33 − x)

⇒ 8 / (x − 8) = 12 / (33 − x)

⇒ 2 / (x − 8) = 3 / (33 − x)

⇒ 2 × (33 − x) = 3 × (x − 8)

⇒ 66 − 2x = 3x − 24

⇒ 5x = 90

⇒ x = 18

⇒ Quantity sold at Rs. 45/kg = 18 − 8 = 10 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 10 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mixtures & Alligation Rule

It allows finding the ratio in which two ingredients at given prices must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired price: Quantity 1 / Quantity 2 = (Price 2 − Mean Price) / (Mean Price − Price 1).

Profit and Loss Basics

Selling Price (SP) is calculated as CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100. When multiple parts are sold at different prices, the overall SP is the weighted average of the individual SPs.

Replacement Method

When a quantity 'y' is replaced 'n' times from a total mixture 'x', the remaining quantity of the original substance is given by x × (1 − y/x)ⁿ.
</p

questions.question: A car moves at the speed of 108 km/hr after repairing and moves at the speed of 72 km/hr before repairing. It covers a distance of x km in 3 hours after repairing. How much time will it take to cover a distance of 5 x km before repairing?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Distance **x** = Speed after repair × Time = 108 × 3 = **324 km**.

New distance to cover = 5x = 5 × 324 = **1620 km**.

Time before repair = New Distance ÷ Speed before repair = 1620 ÷ 72.

Time = 22.5 hours = **22 hr 30 min**.

**∴ The correct answer is 22 hr 30 min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of car after repair = **108 km/hr**

Speed of car before repair = **72 km/hr**

Time taken to cover distance **x** (after repair) = **3 hr**

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44af66b2355fcc5ebd39e364edb6410d672f5e595048e091b80bbd660d38c6fb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, calculate the distance **x** using the speed after repair:

⇒ x = 108 km/hr × 3 hr = **324 km**

⇒ Now, calculate the new distance to be covered before repairing (**5x**):

⇒ 5x = 5 × 324 = **1620 km**

⇒ Calculate the time taken to cover 1620 km at the speed of **72 km/hr** (before repair):

⇒ Time = 1620 ÷ 72

⇒ Time = **22.5 hours**

⇒ Since 0.5 hours = 0.5 × 60 minutes = 30 minutes,

⇒ Time = **22 hr 30 min**

**∴ The correct answer is 22 hr 30 min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Proportionality

For a constant distance, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time** (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from **km/hr** to **m/s**, multiply the value by 5/18. To convert from **m/s** to **km/hr**, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If a car covers equal distances at speeds **u** and **v**, then Average Speed = 2uv ÷ (u + v).</p

questions.question: The ratio of incomes of P and Q is 1 ∶ 2. Ratio of income of Q and R is 3 ∶ 2. If one-third of P's income is Rs. 4400 less than the half of P's income, then what is the Q's income?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of incomes of P and Q is 1:2

The ratio of income of Q and R is 3:2

One-third of P's income is Rs. 4400 less than half of P's income.

**Calculation:**

P's income = x

Q's income = 2x (since the ratio of P's income to Q's income is 1:2)

According to the given information:

One-third of P's income is Rs. 4400 less than half of P's income.

(1/3)x = (1/2)× x - 4400

To simplify the equation, we can multiply both sides by 6 to get rid of the fractions:

x/2 - x/3 = 4400

x/6 = 4400

x = 26400

So

Q's income = 2x = 2 × 26400 = 52800

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: What is the value of the expression 1 - 7 + 2 - 8 + 3 - 9 + 4 - 10 + _______ to 100 terms?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The given expression alternates between adding and subtracting the numbers 1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9, 4, 10, and so on.

We can observe that the numbers being added increase by 1 each time, while the numbers being subtracted also increase by 1 each time.

To find the value of the expression to 100 terms, we can group the terms into pairs.

Each pair consists of a positive number and its negative counterpart.

The sum of each pair is always -6 because (-7 + 1 = -6, -8 + 2 = -6, -9 + 3 = -6, and so on).

Since we have 100 terms in total, we can form 50 pairs.

Each pair sums up to -6, so the sum of the 100 terms is:

50 pairs × (-6) = -300

Therefore, the value of the expression 1 - 7 + 2 - 8 + 3 - 9 + 4 - 10 + ... to 100 terms is -300.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If -sin θ + cosec θ = 6, then what is the value of sin θ + cosec θ?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

-sin θ + cosec θ = 6

⇒ -sin θ + 1/sin θ = 6

⇒ 1 - sin² θ = 6 sin θ 

⇒ sin2 θ + 6 sin θ - 1 = 0

Apply quadratic roots formula,

x = (-b ± √b² - 4ac)/2a

Here x = sinθ , a = 1, b = 6, c = -1

⇒ sinθ = (-6 ± √6² - 4 × (-1))/2

⇒ sinθ = (-6 ± √40)/2

⇒ sinθ = (-3 ± √10)

⇒ sin θ + cosec θ = sin θ + 6 + sin θ (cosec θ = 6 + sin θ)

⇒ 2sin θ + 6

⇒ 2(-3 ± √10) + 6

⇒ -6 ± 2√10 + 6

⇒ ± 2√10

⇒ √40

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If a³ + 3a² + 3a = 63, then the value of a² + 2a is:
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let's solve the given equation a³ + 3a² + 3a = 63 and find the value of a² + 2a

We can factor the left side of the equation by recognizing it as a cube of a binomial:

(a + 1)³ = a³ + 3a² + 3a + 1 

Comparing this with the given equation, we have:

(a + 1)³ = 63 + 1

Taking the cube root of both sides, we get:

a + 1 = ∛(64)

Simplifying further, we have:

a + 1 = 4

Subtracting 1 from both sides:

a = 4 - 1

a = 3

Now we can find the value of a² + 2a:

a² + 2a = 3² + 2(3) = 9 + 6 = 15

Therefore, the value of a² + 2a is 15.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: How many prime numbers are there between 100 and 120?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

List all **odd numbers** between 100 and 120: 101, 103, 105, 107, 109, 111, 113, 115, 117, 119.

Remove multiples of 3 (sum of digits): 111 (1+1+1=3) and 117 (1+1+7=9).

Remove multiples of 5: 105 and 115.

Remove multiples of 7: 119 (7 × 17).

Remaining **prime numbers**: 101, 103, 107, 109, 113.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Range between 100 and 120.

**Formula:** A number is **prime** if it is not divisible by any prime number less than or equal to its square root (√n). For n [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd5fc9d75c94ac9343854fb7cba8ff70b654c527b40113fb73fbb9a4cd269eca.png] 

⇒ Divisibility test for **111**: 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 (Divisible by 3)

⇒ Divisibility test for **117**: 1 + 1 + 7 = 9 (Divisible by 3 and 9)

⇒ Divisibility test for **119**: 119 ÷ 7 = 17 (Divisible by 7)

⇒ Count of primes = 101, 103, 107, 109, 113 = 5 prime numbers.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers (1 to 100)

There are exactly **25 prime numbers** between 1 and 100. The smallest is 2, which is also the only even prime number.

Divisibility Rule for 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 3.

Testing for Primality

To check if a number **n** is prime, test divisibility by all primes up to **√n**. If none divide **n**, then **n** is prime.</p

questions.question: The average of 16 numbers is 35. It was found later that four numbers 18, 17, 24 and 35 were taken by mistake. What is the new average after removing these numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Original average of 16 numbers = 35

Net deviation of removed numbers (18, 17, 24, 35) = (−17) + (−18) + (−11) + 0 = −46

Removing numbers with a negative net deviation increases the average of the remaining values.

Increase in average = 46 ÷ 12 = 3.83

New average = 35 + 3.83 = 38.83

**∴ The correct answer is 38.83.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 16 numbers = 35

Removed numbers = 18, 17, 24 and 35

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of numbers ÷ Total numbers

 
 
 
• 
 4 removed
 12 remaining
 Sum = 94
 Sum = 466
 New Avg = 38.83
 Total: 16 numbers, Avg = 35, Sum = 560

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total sum of 16 numbers = 16 × 35 = 560

⇒ Sum of removed numbers = 18 + 17 + 24 + 35 = 94

⇒ Total sum of remaining 12 numbers = 560 − 94 = 466

⇒ New average = 466 ÷ 12

⇒ New average = 233 ÷ 6 = 38.83

**∴ The correct answer is 38.83.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Basic Concept

The average of a set of numbers is the sum of the values divided by the total count of numbers.

Net Deviation Method

Removing items with a net negative deviation from the overall average increases the average of the remaining items. Similarly, removing positive deviations decreases the average.

Weighted Average

When combining two groups, the combined average is calculated as (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p

questions.question: JKLM is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠K is opposite to ∠M. When JK and ML are produced, meet at point Z. JK = 10 cm, KZ = 12 cm and MZ = 33 cm. What is the length of LZ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cyclic quadrilateral** where sides are produced to meet at point Z, the **secant-secant property** states: ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM.

Total length ZJ = ZK + JK = 12 + 10 = 22 cm.

Applying the formula: 12 × 22 = ZL × 33

⇒ 264 = 33 × ZL

⇒ ZL = 264 ÷ 33 = 8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

JK = 10 cm, KZ = 12 cm, MZ = 33 cm

JKLM is a **cyclic quadrilateral**.

**Formula Used:**

Intersecting Secant Theorem: When two secant lines intersect at an external point Z, the product of the external segment and the whole secant is equal for both lines: **ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09936af70abab110df4872ae0270c3b2cd3e53703e202a3034a322a2f80d8dbb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total length of secant ZJ = ZK + JK

⇒ ZJ = 12 + 10 = 22 cm

⇒ According to theorem, ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM

⇒ 12 × 22 = ZL × 33

⇒ 264 = 33 × ZL

⇒ ZL = 264 ÷ 33

⇒ ZL = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

In a **cyclic quadrilateral**, the sum of opposite angles is 180°. Also, the exterior angle at any vertex is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Power of a Point Theorem

For an external point Z, the product of segments of any secant line is constant (ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM = Constant), which is also equal to the square of the tangent length from that point.

Similar Triangles

When sides of a cyclic quadrilateral are produced, the triangle formed by the intersection point and the nearer vertices is **similar** to the triangle formed with the farther vertices (▵ZKL ∼ ▵ZMJ).</p
